facts.text: The party holds Cedric's signed promissory note for their barrow treasure, tallied at 975 gold pieces (three-quarters price), payable once the caravans flow again and the goods can be trucked to town.
The party owes the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment from Cedric's promissory note in return for joining the party for the dragon hunt.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated how much of the note each recruit gets or when they are paid.
